trap-nonspeakable.notes: MATH FINDING (report, not fixed). Clause 3 says a Hecke step 'changes energy by |c|.|q-q^{-1}|' and that 'Every Hecke step increases the total weight'. Recomputed: replacing sigma_i^2 inside a term c.w of length l gives c(q-q^{-1})w' with l(w')=l-1 plus c.w'' with l(w'')=l-2, so Delta E = |c|[(q-q^{-1})(l-1) - 2], NOT |c|.|q-q^{-1}|. The two agree only at l = 2 + 2/(q-q^{-1}) = 11.57 at the proton pin (q-q^{-1} = 0.2090602987956394). Worse, Delta E < 0 for every l below the breakeven l = 1 + 2/(q-q^{-1}) = 10.5666, e.g. Delta E = -1.791|c| for the shortest case l=2 (w = sigma_i^2 alone), so the monotonicity claim 'Every Hecke step increases the total weight' fails for all short words. Either the energy functional's length weighting or clause 3's per-step formula needs restating; as written they are inconsistent.
